attribution: GeoSpec glTF part-contract fixtures: hand-built unit cubes in core glTF 2.0 (plus EXT_mesh_manifold where named), written by generate.mjs in this directory (Node 24, no dependencies). No CAD kernel or exporter produced them, and none carries extras.
runtimeDependency: Tests read the files in this directory; the generator is not run by any test.
bytePolicy: Regeneration is byte-identical: run `node generate.mjs .` in this directory.

files.description: One closed unit cube whose faces z0, z1 and y0 are node 'Top' and y1, x0 and x1 are node 'Side' (6 triangles each): toBeWatertight fails with 16 open edges, 8 of them welded edges open in both nodes.

The same twelve triangles as two TRIANGLES primitives of one node 'part' sharing one POSITION accessor: toBeWatertight passes; toHaveConnectedComponents refuses, since each undeclared primitive is an open operand.
two-primitives.glb whose mesh declares EXT_mesh_manifold over the shared POSITION accessor and the whole index stream: toBeWatertight passes and toHaveConnectedComponents counts one body.
Two closed unit cubes 'A' and 'B', B offset by (0.5, 0.5, 0.5): toBeWatertight passes.
Two closed unit cubes 'A' and 'B' sharing the face x = 1: toBeWatertight passes.
The same two cubes, both nodes named 'part': the shared face's five welded edges carry four triangles, so toBeWatertight fails with 5 non-manifold edges.
The split cube of split-two-nodes.glb with face x1 missing: toBeWatertight fails with 14 open edges, 5 of them open in both nodes.
A closed unit cube 'A' and one triangle 'B' on A's edge from (1, 0, 0) to (0, 0, 0): toBeWatertight fails with B's 3 open edges, none shared with A.
